context:
The label lanes need your TCGTracking shipper number in the main checkout's settings file.
Why yours: the env-file guard refuses every agent write to .env (tcgtracking session, 2026-10-27 23:51 CDT, and this session's read was refused 2026-11-02), and Claude in Chrome was not connected on two tries to look the number up in your TCGTracking account.
ref: Item 105 (shipper number); D326, the TCGTracking pipe
steps: Find your shipper number in your TCGTracking account settings.
Paste the command below in a terminal, with your number in place of <your number>.
